likelyQuestions: Find an optimal parenthesisation of the matrix-chain product with the given dimensions.
Explain the Rabin–Karp algorithm and find the spurious hits for the given text and pattern modulo q.
Apply Strassen's algorithm to the given matrices and analyse its complexity.
Run the Bellman–Ford algorithm on the given graph from the source and show how it detects negative-weight cycles.
Discuss the classes P, NP, NP-hard and NP-complete with a diagram, and the steps to prove a problem NP-complete.
Solve the recurrences T(n) = 2T(√n) + log n and T(n) = 4T(n/2) + n²√n.
Construct the Huffman tree for the given characters and frequencies and calculate the total bits needed.
Explain the N-Queen problem and solve the 4/5-queen problem using backtracking with the state-space tree.
Discuss Big-O and Big-Omega notations and prove that ½n(n−1) = O(n²) by finding c and n₀.
Find the minimum spanning tree of the given graph using Kruskal's algorithm and analyse its complexity.
